parameters.name: Direction
parameters.description: The sort order. Valid values: `asc`: ascending. `desc`: descending.

sub_parameters.name: EffectiveType
sub_parameters.description: The type of the effective scope. Valid value: `account`.

sub_parameters.name: Scope
sub_parameters.description: A list of scope values that correspond to the specified `EffectiveType`. For example, if `EffectiveType` is set to `account`, this parameter contains a list of account IDs for users that use recursive resolution.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries to return. Valid values: **1** to **100**. Default value: **20**.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The token to retrieve the next page of results.

parameters.name: OrderBy
parameters.description: The sort field. Valid values: `UpdateTime`: the update time of the zone. `RecordCount`: the number of DNS records.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. Pages start at **1**. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return per page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20.

parameters.name: Remark
parameters.description: The remark for the zone. Fuzzy search is supported.
